steps.title: Cockpit home — thesis strip visible in idle state
steps.narration: The trading cockpit loads cleanly. Between the chart and the panel grid you can already see the thesis strip sitting in its idle state, inviting you to declare a thesis on whatever ticker you are watching.
steps.point_out: The 'Declare a thesis' prompt in the thesis strip area — the new strip section is present and ready even before a watch is started.

steps.title: Select SIM-BUYER and start watching
steps.narration: Choosing the SIM-BUYER simulated ticker and hitting Watch starts a live tape stream. The thesis strip stays in idle state, ready for a declaration.
steps.point_out: Tape prints begin updating and the thesis strip idle prompt remains visible beneath the chart.

steps.title: Click Watch to begin the tape stream
steps.narration: With SIM-BUYER entered, clicking Watch connects to the live tape. Price prints start flowing and the cockpit is now in an active-watch state.
steps.point_out: The tape display shows updating price data and the thesis strip idle affordance is still present below the chart.

steps.title: Open the thesis declaration form
steps.narration: Clicking 'Declare a thesis' opens the declaration form right inside the strip. This is where you commit a directional read — setup type, direction, and an invalidation price level.
steps.point_out: The declaration form appears with fields for setup type, direction, and invalidation price — all the parameters needed to define what would prove the thesis wrong.
